| Deploy on table. Your {{Errata hl|1=gamblers, smugglers, spies and information brokers are each forfeit +1}} and their forfeit may not be reduced. When you activate Force, you may {{Errata hl|1=activate 3 additional Force}} for each character on table with “plotting to kill Jabba” in their lore. ({{Errata hl|1=Immune to Alter.}}) || Deploy on table. Your {{Errata hl|1=aliens of ability &lt; 3}} may not have their forfeit values reduced ({{Errata hl|1=except by Molator}}). Your {{Errata hl|1=battle destiny draws are +1}} where you have a character with “plotting to kill Jabba” in lore. May lose 1 Force to {{Errata hl|1=raise your converted [Jabba's Palace] site to the top}}.
